faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Have questions about booking bus tickets on GoKawsar ? Reach out to Kawsar Developer or find fast answers right here.
faq.still_help_desc: Cant find the answer you are looking for? Please contact Kawsar Developer & our support team.

questions.q1: Can I buy any Bus Tickets from GoKawsar?
questions.a1: Ofcourse you can. With GoKawsar you can compare, book any available bus route at that moment from one screen seamlessly.
questions.q2: What kind of payment do you accept?
questions.a2: We accept all major payment options in Bangladesh including bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Visa, Mastercard, and Internet Banking.
questions.a3: Yes, cash payments are accepted for counter collections. However, for instant online seat confirmation, digital payment is recommended.
questions.q4: How do I get my Ticket?
questions.a4: Once your payment is confirmed, an E-Ticket with booking ID will be sent to your email & phone via SMS. You can also download it directly from your account dashboard.
questions.q5: Can I cancel or reschedule my bus ticket?
questions.a5: Yes, you can request a cancellation or schedule change from your user dashboard at least 6 hours before the bus departure time.
questions.q6: Do I need to print my E-Ticket?
questions.a6: In most cases, showing the SMS or digital PDF ticket on your mobile phone at the bus counter is sufficient to collect your boarding pass.

how_to_use.title: How to Book Tickets
how_to_use.subtitle: Booking bus tickets on
how_to_use.subtitle_end: is quick and straightforward. Follow these steps to complete your reservation in just a few minutes.
how_to_use.step1_desc: Select your starting location, destination, travel date, and search for available buses.
how_to_use.step2_desc: Filter options by operator, time, or AC type, and choose your preferred seats from the seat map.
how_to_use.step3_desc: Enter the passenger details like Name, Phone Number, and Email for ticket issuance.
how_to_use.step4_desc: Complete the payment through your preferred method to instantly receive your E-Ticket via SMS and Email.
how_to_use.need_help_desc: Check our frequently asked questions or contact support for assistance.

refund_policy.section1_p1: Refunds will be processed within 1 to 14 business days, depending on the payment method used.
refund_policy.section1_p2: The refund will be credited via the same payment channel used for payment.
refund_policy.section2_p1: GoKawsar follows the airline's cancellation and reissue policies.
refund_policy.section2_p2: Travelers must request cancellations or changes at least 48 hours before departure to avoid no-show charges.
refund_policy.section2_p3: Cancellations or reissues require contacting GoKawsar support or via GoKawsar Chat.
refund_policy.section2_p4: Airlines may charge a cancellation or reissue fee, and GoKawsar may impose additional service fees beyond airline fees.
refund_policy.section2_p5: EMI-related charges, if applicable, will be deducted from the refund amount.
refund_policy.section3_p1: GoKawsar follows each property's cancellation policy.
refund_policy.section3_p2: Travelers must cancel bookings via GoKawsar Chat or by contacting GoKawsar support.
refund_policy.section3_p3: Cancellation fees may apply based on the hotel's terms and cancellation timing.
refund_policy.section3_p4: Changes are dependent on hotel's terms and conditions.
refund_policy.section3_p5: Black-out date bookings are non-cancellable and non-refundable.
refund_policy.section3_p6: EMI-related charges, if applicable, will be deducted from the refund amount.
refund_policy.section4_p1: "GoKawsar Flex Search" combines flights from different airlines under one itinerary, each subject to individual airline policies.
refund_policy.section4_p2: If a flight in a "GoKawsar Flex Search" is not booked or issued, it will be refunded or reissued as per the respective airline's policy.
refund_policy.section4_p3: Flight fares are subject to change based on airline availability and policies.
refund_policy.section4_p4: Any changes or cancellations must be handled directly with the respective airline.
refund_policy.section4_p5: Refund, cancellation, or date change requests will follow airline policies along with GoKawsar's service fees.
refund_policy.section4_p6: GoKawsar is not liable for issues arising from combining flights from different airlines.
refund_policy.section4_p7: Travel insurance is recommended to cover unforeseen events.
refund_policy.section5_p1: Visa fees and service charges are strictly non-refundable, even in cases where a visa is denied.
refund_policy.section6_p1: GoKawsar is not liable for disruptions due to natural disasters, strikes, or government-imposed restrictions.
